text: Houthi missiles struck the presidential palace in Aden, killing five, per Watchboard's Yemen tracker entry for Oct 16. It follows a day of Saudi-Houthi escalation: Riyadh called the attacks on civilian facilities war crimes, and WFP warned the humanitarian crisis will worsen.

judge.comment: Significant development, but the casualty figure comes from a single event entry and source tier is not shown in the prompt data; a human should confirm sourcing before posting.

factChecks.claim: Houthi missiles struck the presidential palace in Aden, killing five
Saudi Arabia called Houthi attacks on civilian facilities war crimes
WFP warned the humanitarian crisis will worsen

text: How many people are missing after the Nepal floods? Nepal Police: 4,718 on 30 Sep, 5,132 as of 14 Oct. Other compilations: 5,285 to 6,145, with about 1,000 names added by bookkeeping. Confirmed dead per Nepal Police: 1,456. The search phase has ended; the gap has not closed.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with dates; contested type never auto-approves. The 'about 1,000 names added by bookkeeping' detail is from the tracker's dispute summary and should be eyeballed.

factChecks.source: Nepal-china-flash-floods unresolved dispute: How many people are missing?

factChecks.claim: Nepal Police: 5,132 missing as of 14 Oct

factChecks.source: Unresolved dispute: How many people are missing?
Dispute summary says '~1,000 names added by bookkeeping'; context is brief

text: How much Russian refining capacity is actually down? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (July 2026). IEA: losses "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries partly offset the losses. Three measures, one campaign.

judge.comment: Figures and attributions match the tracker's disputed-figure entry; the measures differ in what they count (capacity vs throughput), which the tweet hints at without adjudicating. Contested type requires human review.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
factChecks.source: Unresolved dispute: How much Russian refining capacity has been disabled?

factChecks.claim: IEA said losses were more than 20% at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%
